title.purpose: Card titles such as guide and office names.

body-small.purpose: Secondary text only: summaries, metadata, and supporting notes.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards a resident can open, on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on any screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-bay-700, #194b80); color: #fff; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-bay-800, #153d69); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f5c98; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #44403c; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fafaf9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f5c98; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A field with a persistent label above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #44403c; } .ds-input { width: 240px; background: #fff; color: #1c1917; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2f72b0; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(47 114 176 / 0.2); }

components.name: Header Link
components.description: Navigation on the navy header, with a gold bar on the active page.
components.html: Service guidesAgenciesOffices
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; background: var(--color-navy, #102f54); padding: 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 20px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5c451; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { color: #f5c451; } .ds-nav-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 9999px 9999px 0 0; background: #f5c451; }

components.name: Verification Badge
components.description: Shows how well information is confirmed, always with an icon and words.
components.html: Verified
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #ecfdf5; color: #065f46; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #a7f3d0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Guide Card
components.description: Opens a service guide. Flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html: SSSApply for an SSS numberWhat to bring and where to go to get your number.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 280px; padding: 20px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #85b5dd; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f5c98; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-agency { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #925f08; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.375; color: #0a1f3a; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; color: #57534e; }

components.name: Callout
components.description: The one attention surface: a soft fill and a single 4px left accent.
components.html: Details can change: Confirm with the agency before you go.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; max-width: 420px; padding: 20px; background: rgb(255 250 235 / 0.6); border-left: 4px solid #f5b301; border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; color: #44403c; } .ds-callout p { margin: 0; padding-top: 4px; } .ds-callout strong { color: #0a1f3a; } .ds-callout-icon { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #925f08; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #ffe285; }

components.name: Checklist Row
components.description: The signature component: the whole row is the tap target.
components.css: .ds-check { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 300px; padding: 16px; background: rgb(236 253 245 / 0.6); border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-check-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-check-box { display: flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: 2px; border-radius: 4px; background: #059669; color: #fff; } .ds-check-input:focus-visible + .ds-check-box { outline: 2px solid #2f72b0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check-text { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #78716c; text-decoration: line-through; }

narrative.overview:
Andam GenSan looks and behaves like a well-kept folder you carry to a government office: everything labeled, in order, and ticked off. A resident arrives with a stressful errand, on a phone, possibly on mobile data. The design's job is to lower that stress, so it stays calm and capable. Nothing competes with the question "what do I bring, and where do I go?"

Controls are sturdy and obvious. Someone unsure of technology should never have to guess what can be tapped. Familiar patterns are a strength here. Personality comes from the deep navy, the yellowfin gold, and quiet local touches such as the Sarangani Bay contour lines, not from effects.

The design must never pass as an official government website. It must not clone a reference site, including gensanjobboard.com, and screens must not look machine-generated.
keyCharacteristics: One family of navy blues from the header to the buttons, with gold used sparingly as a marker
A light Bay Mist page with flat white surfaces and thin borders
One typeface, with hierarchy built from weight and size
Status always shown with an icon and words, never color alone
The same structure in English, Bisaya, Filipino, and Hiligaynon, whichever runs longest

rules.name: The Uniform Navy Rule
rules.body: The header, footer, buttons, and links all come from the same navy family. No section introduces its own hue.

rules.name: The Gold Marks Rule
rules.body: Gold marks position, progress, or attention. It is never the fill of a primary button, and it is never the color of small text on white; use Yellowfin Text there.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Every status carries its own icon and wording, so it never depends on color alone.

rules.name: The Sixteen Rule
rules.body: Anything a resident must read to act, such as requirements, steps, and instructions, is at least 16px on a phone.

rules.name: The Bold Lead-In Rule
rules.body: Items in a reminder or callout list start with a bold key takeaway, such as "**Protect your accounts:** Never share..."

rules.name: The Flat Until It Floats Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest unless it floats above the page.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: Every control a resident taps on a phone is at least 44px tall. Small inline links, such as breadcrumbs, are at least 24px.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: A callout has a soft fill and one 4px left accent. It never also has an outer stroke, so the two borders do not compete. This is the owner's confirmed style, and it applies only to callouts.

dos: Do keep the checklist and steps as the most prominent content on a guide, with the checklist starting within the first phone screen.
Do show "Not yet verified" plainly wherever information is unconfirmed.
Do use one icon style (lucide, outline) at one size within a group, and align list icons to the first line of text.
Do test every new layout at phone width in all four languages.
Do keep motion short and functional, under 300ms, with a reduced-motion alternative.
Do blend reference sites into something original, using this palette.
donts: Don't make any screen look or read like an official government website, or use the official GenSan city seal as a logo.
Don't clone a single reference site, including gensanjobboard.com.
Don't add a new hue for a section, or use a different navy from the family above.
Don't add a small label above a heading. Supporting details such as an agency name or an updated date go below it.
Don't put a card inside a card. Section content sits directly in the section, and a section made of cards has no outer card.
Don't combine a thick left accent with a full outer stroke on the same card.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glass, or decorative glows.
Don't show a statistic or a verified state that the data does not support.
